figurative_meaning_en: to verbally abuse or hurl insults
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথায় কথায় সে মুখ চালাতে শুরু করল।
এই লোকটা সবসময় মুখ চালিয়ে ঝগড়া করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He started running his mouth in the middle of the argument.
This guy always talks trash and picks fights.
note: This idiom reflects informal Bengali verbal interactions, often used in heated exchanges.
